baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ص و ب at words 2 and 4 joins the event's arrival to the event named, while the exception with إِذْن bounds its occurrence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A misfortune is pictured simultaneously as something descending and as something reaching its point of impact; divine permission contains that landing without yet explaining its purpose.

activation_trace.role: Downward arrival makes the occurrence a landing into the human situation rather than an abstract fact.
Target-reaching makes the repeated root carry a point of impact and directed contact.
Granted leave supplies the boundary under which the impact occurs, not a stated humanly visible purpose.

changed_reading.before: No misfortune happens except with divine permission.
changed_reading.after: The misfortune is narrated as a landing that reaches its point of impact within divine leave, making randomness less available while leaving purpose unstated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence يُؤْمِن -> يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ links believing to an action performed upon the heart.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trust quiets fear enough for gentle direction, and the heart's own turning range makes guidance an active reorientation rather than a static deposit of consolation.

activation_trace.role: Inner security supplies the receptive condition that prevents impact from fixing the heart in fear.
Heart-settling assent makes belief a trusted reception of truth rather than bare acknowledgment.
Gentle indication toward a way supplies the directional action applied to the believer.
Capacity to turn from face to face makes the heart the moving element in the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Faith is rewarded by an inward feeling of comfort.
changed_reading.after: Faith makes the struck inner faculty receptive to being turned toward a viable direction; comfort may result, but reorientation is primary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ expands from one impact and one heart to every knowable thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The incident and the heart's hidden turn are enclosed within an undivided field of knowledge; knowledge also marks and distinguishes a way, linking the closure back to guidance.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion prevents the final clause from being limited to the visible incident alone.
The broadest knowable object includes occurrence, response, and concealed interior change.
Disclosure to the knower grounds the claim that no part of the process is epistemically absent to God.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward something creates a secondary bridge from knowing to the heart's directed path.

changed_reading.before: The omniscience clause is a general doctrinal ending.
changed_reading.after: The ending encloses impact, belief, and the heart's otherwise hidden turn within one known whole and subtly echoes path-marking guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier field of capacity and measured determination sharpens permission into a bounded fit: the event reaches a particular limit rather than spilling outside all measure.

activation_trace.role: The focus event contributes the point actually reached.
Permission supplies the enclosing authorization, which does not by itself assert benefit.
A thing reaching its determinate limit supplies bounded magnitude to the event's landing.
Deliberate measuring supplies an ordered frame within which permission can be read.

structural_cues: 64:1 closes with power over every thing; 64:11 closes with knowledge of every thing after one event reaches one heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, capacity, permission, and impact; I infer a bounded fit between them. Alternatively, ق د ر may describe general power without individuating this event's measure.

changed_reading.before: Permission means only that the event was allowed to occur.
changed_reading.after: Permission can also be heard as containing a measured landing with a limit, though the text still does not disclose why that limit was chosen.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is measured into form and proceeds toward a destination; against that sequence, the impact-to-guidance movement can be read as a transition that reforms the heart's direction rather than merely ending pain.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and intended course anchor the model in the focus verb of guidance.
Turning from one face to another supplies the heart's capacity for changed trajectory.
Measuring before formation supplies an ordered beginning for the trajectory.
Given form supplies the possibility that inward response itself can be re-formed.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the forward arrow that joins form to eventual direction.

structural_cues: 64:3 orders creation, forming, and destination; 64:11 orders impact, belief, guidance, and comprehensive knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, form, destination, heart-turning, and direction; I infer that the event can occasion re-formation of trajectory. Alternatively, 64:3 may frame only cosmic creation, not post-impact inner change.

changed_reading.before: Guidance supplies the correct answer after a misfortune.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can re-form the heart's course after impact, placing the believer in an ongoing becoming toward a destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The heart is not reduced to emotion: it is the concealed source from which action proceeds, fully known even when its turn has not become public conduct.

activation_trace.role: The heart as understanding and inner faculty anchors the locus that is guided.
Complete knowing anchors the closure around the heart's concealed change.
Repeated knowing across hidden and disclosed material extends knowledge into the interior process.
Concealment in the interior identifies the zone in which the first change can remain unseen.
An origin from which acts issue makes inward guidance causally relevant to later conduct.

structural_cues: 64:4 contrasts what is concealed and declared, then names the interior of breasts; 64:11 places guidance directly on the heart and closes with knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, an inward source of acts, the heart, and divine knowing; I infer an interior-to-conduct arrow. Alternatively, the heart may denote understanding without implying a specific later act.

changed_reading.before: God knows that the believer feels inwardly guided.
changed_reading.after: God guides and knows the concealed action-source whose reorientation can later issue as visible conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear disclosure and illuminating guidance can be received or turned away from; therefore belief under permission is a receptive act, not fatalistic surrender to whatever happens.

activation_trace.role: Assent trusted by the heart anchors an active reception in the focus condition.
Disclosure through speech or sign supplies content that can be received rather than mere coercion.
Contextual guidance supplies the offered direction that the speakers reject.
Turning away supplies the live negative counterpart to the focus heart's guided turn.
Illumination supplies what makes a path perceptible to the receptive heart.

structural_cues: 64:6 stages guidance refused and turning away; 64:8 commands belief in the sent-down light before 64:11 conditions heart-guidance on belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosed signs, guidance, refusal, light, and belief; I infer that reception mediates heart-guidance. Alternatively, the focus conditional may state consequence without describing a psychological reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Belief means passively accepting that the event was permitted.
changed_reading.after: Belief is receptive alignment with disclosed direction, the opposite of turning away; permitted impact does not erase responsive agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated belief construction links final gathering and present heart-guidance: guidance can gather an inner life dispersed by impact and keep the event from becoming heedless loss.

activation_trace.role: The heart's turn anchors the present inner reconfiguration after impact.
Joining what was dispersed supplies a repair image for the struck heart.
Loss through inattention supplies the failure that gathered guidance resists.
The same heart-settling assent links the gathering scene to the focus conditional.

structural_cues: 64:9 and 64:11 repeat وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِٱللَّهِ, first before final repair and then before guidance of the heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax, gathering, preventable loss, and heart-turning; I infer that present guidance gathers the post-impact interior. Alternatively, the two conditionals may parallel rewards without making gathering an inner mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Heart-guidance is an isolated private benefit after the event.
changed_reading.after: Heart-guidance is a present gathering of what impact dispersed, anticipating a larger gathering and resisting loss through heedlessness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The guided heart moves from acknowledging permission into obedience and entrusted dependence; trust releases control while preserving commanded action.

activation_trace.role: Permission sets the limit of what lies outside the believer's control.
Gentle direction anchors what the believer can do within that limit.
Willing compliance supplies the active consequence of inward direction.
Reliant entrustment supplies release of outcomes without release of duty.
The believing group is characterized by secure reliance, reconnecting trust to the focus condition.

structural_cues: Immediately after 64:11, 64:12 commands obedience and 64:13 commands believers to rely on God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, guidance, obedience, and entrustment; I infer a division between uncontrollable outcome and controllable response. Alternatively, the adjacent commands may be general duties rather than the content of this heart-guidance.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is resignation because the event was divinely permitted.
changed_reading.after: Guidance distinguishes surrendered outcome from active response: the believer entrusts what cannot be controlled and obeys within what can.

context_deltas.mechanism: When harm arises inside intimate bonds, heart-guidance becomes a controlled sequence: recognize transgression, remain alert, erase its track, turn the page, and cover the offender from continuing effect.

activation_trace.role: Turning the inner faculty anchors the possibility of changing one's face toward relational injury.
Actual hostility supplies the harm that guidance must negotiate without denying it.
Wakeful protection prevents forgiveness from being equated with blindness to danger.
Effacement supplies removal of the injury's continuing trace.
Turning and inspecting pages gives the heart's turn a concrete ethical procedure rather than simple forgetting.
Protective covering of fault supplies containment of its effect on the wrongdoer and relationship.

structural_cues: 64:14 names hostility within spouses and children, commands caution, then coordinates three escalating acts of release.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intimate hostility, caution, erasure, page-turning, and protective covering; I infer that these acts specify one social form of heart-guidance. Alternatively, they may be independent commands rather than a staged sequence.

changed_reading.before: A guided heart merely endures relational harm calmly.
changed_reading.after: A guided heart can remain lucid about danger while actively turning the injury from retaliation into effacement, a new page, and protective forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later metal-assay image activates a diagnostic reading: impact exposes which attachment occupies the heart's core, and guidance reorients that core after exposure.

activation_trace.role: The calamity branch anchors the painful event that presses upon the person.
The pure inner core supplies what the event may expose and guidance may reorder.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the diagnostic pressure that reveals composition.

structural_cues: 64:15 predicates testing of wealth and children immediately after 64:14's intimate conflict and before 64:16's self-restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calamity, an inner core, and assay; I infer that some impacts reveal attachment before guidance reorders it. Alternatively, the stated test may be limited to wealth and children and should not classify every misfortune as an assay.

changed_reading.before: The event is only an external loss followed by internal compensation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the impact can expose the heart's operative alloy, so guidance includes recognizing and reordering what the loss revealed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Involuntary diminishment is answered by chosen cutting-away for another's benefit; the heart's new direction converts the experience of loss into generous release under a horizon of increase.

activation_trace.role: The adverse event anchors involuntary loss or pain as the starting pressure.
A changed course anchors the move from being deprived to deliberately releasing.
Cutting off wealth or work for returned recompense supplies voluntary relinquishment.
Increase by another like amount supplies a future beyond the apparent subtraction.
A small input becoming sufficient and visibly effective supplies disproportionate fruit from release.

structural_cues: 64:16 commands expenditure after protection from inner avarice; 64:17 recasts giving as a loan that is increased.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies involuntary impact, changed direction, chosen cutting, increase, and visible effect; I infer a response pattern from suffered loss to generosity. Alternatively, the giving command need not arise from prior personal loss.

changed_reading.before: Guidance helps the believer absorb what has been taken away.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may redirect the experience of being diminished into a voluntary release that refuses scarcity as the heart's governing logic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final concealed/manifest pair broadens the focus closure: the permission behind impact may remain unseen while the heart's guided turn becomes witnessable, and both remain under discerning wisdom.

activation_trace.role: Knowing every aspect anchors the focus claim that hidden cause and visible consequence are both held.
The closing recurrence of knowing carries the focus claim into the surah's final frame.
Concealment from sight supplies the opacity of permission, purpose, and inward beginnings.
Presence with observation supplies the domain where guided conduct can become visible.
Knowledge that reaches the fitting judgment supplies a qualified bridge from omniscience to wise direction.

structural_cues: 64:18 ends the surah with a nominal sequence of knower, concealed, witnessed, mighty, and wise, echoing 64:11's final عَلِيمٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive knowing, concealed and witnessed domains, and fitting wisdom; I infer a hidden-to-visible arc from permission to guided conduct. Alternatively, both domains may simply state exhaustive knowledge without temporal movement.

changed_reading.before: The reason for the event should become intelligible if the heart is guided.
changed_reading.after: Guidance need not disclose the hidden reason; it can make a faithful response visible while hidden and witnessed alike remain within wise knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses two non-dominant mapped inventories, so it is form-distant and must be rendered as a lexical activation, not as an alternate translation. It remains anchored in the focus event, guidance verb, and turning heart; its value is to preserve the possibility that guidance works through internal breakage rather than bypassing it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The impact, يَهْدِ, and قَلْبَهُ stand in one causal sequence, while the packet maps the first and third roots to inventories of exhaustion and severe breaking.

activation_trace.role: The split inventory contributes exhausting affliction as the bodily and psychic pressure of the event.
The non-dominant mapping contributes severe breakage or collapse inside the position occupied by guidance.
Turning the heart supplies reconstitution as a new orientation after what was broken.

changed_reading.before: Guidance arrives after the damage as an intact answer from outside it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance may include the breaking of an untenable inner structure and the re-turning that follows, so damage becomes part of reconstitution without being called good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ear/hearing branches of ء ذ ن are surprising beside the ordinary authorization sense, and downstream prose should present them as resonance rather than replace that sense. The reading remains anchored by إِذْن in the focus and is activated by the later command to hear and comply.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same ء ذ ن inventory that supplies permission also carries ear and receptive hearing, beside the focus movement from belief to heart-guidance.

activation_trace.role: The ear supplies a concrete aperture through which an otherwise opaque event can become addressable.
Attentive acceptance supplies a receptive undertone inside the permission word's wider inventory.
Direction anchors what receptive hearing could make available to the heart.
Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance activates the reception mechanism contextually.

changed_reading.before: Permission is only a legal-metaphysical condition on the event.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, permission also opens an aural posture: the believer can receive direction through an event whose authorization remains otherwise opaque.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain hydraulic analogy and should be marked as such, not made the verse's lexical meaning. It remains anchored in the focus root's rain-like descent and the heart's turning, with later branches supplying retention and outflow; it preserves a changed reading of guidance as altered circulation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus event can descend like rain and the heart can turn; 64:16 contrasts a self that holds tightly with expenditure that sends resources outward.

activation_trace.role: Rain-like descent supplies the incoming flow that strikes the human catchment.
Turning supplies a gate-like change in how the heart routes what reaches it.
Ground that holds back its runoff supplies the image of defensive inner retention.
Resources leaving in expenditure supply the outward flow opposed to hoarding.
A through-passage with an outlet supplies circulation rather than terminal loss.

changed_reading.before: Guidance keeps the impact contained safely inside the believer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance changes circulation: what descends does not harden into defensive retention but is routed outward as responsive generosity.

strongest_changes: Permission ceased to imply passivity once measure, reception, obedience, and trust were activated around it.
Guidance of the heart became dynamic turning, gathering, and re-forming rather than a private consoling message.
The later family, restraint, and giving sequences gave inward guidance visible ethical forms: lucid caution, forgiveness, and release from scarcity.
The final concealed/witnessed frame allowed guidance to produce visible response without promising disclosure of the event's hidden reason.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled impact root linked descent, target-contact, and calamity; split mappings then preserved breakage and exhaustion as contained alternatives, while page-turning, assay, and hydraulic branches exposed several coexisting mechanisms for how a heart changes.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrow from divine permission to a specifically measured individual purpose is inferred and may be weaker than the simpler authorization reading.
The heart may foreground understanding, affect, volition, or their integration; the packet does not force one faculty model.
The split-root breakage, receptive-hearing, assay, and hydraulic activations are intentionally exploratory and should not be lexicalized as direct translations.
Adjacent commands may exemplify the fruit of heart-guidance without exhaustively defining it.
